caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a simple, rustic design. The chair has four straight legs colored in a reddish-brown hue. The backrest consists of four horizontal, curved slats in a matching reddish-brown color, each evenly spaced, set between two vertical posts that terminate in small finials at the top. The seat of the chair is woven from a straw-colored material. The legs are connected by horizontal support rods on each side as well as at the back and front, forming a squared structure just above the floor. The drawing is centered on a light beige background that has a few faint, technical sketches and dimensions in the corners but contains no other main objects or decorations.
title: Chair
